seller_product_submissions_category_chec.name: seller_product_submissions_category_check
seller_product_submissions_category_chec.value: "seller_product_submissions"."category" in ('Laptops', 'Screens', 'Woofers', 'Accessories', 'Phones & Tablets', 'Home & Kitchen', 'Fashion', 'Beauty & Health', 'School & Office', 'Groceries', 'Sports & Outdoors')

seller_product_submissions_submitted_sta.name: seller_product_submissions_submitted_status_check
seller_product_submissions_submitted_sta.value: "seller_product_submissions"."status" not in ('SUBMITTED', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') or "seller_product_submissions"."submitted_at" is not null

seller_product_submissions_review_check.name: seller_product_submissions_review_check
seller_product_submissions_review_check.value:
(
        "seller_product_submissions"."status" = 'UNDER_REVIEW' and
        "seller_product_submissions"."review_started_at" is not null and
        "seller_product_submissions"."reviewed_at" is null and
        "seller_product_submissions"."review_reason" is null
      ) or (
        "seller_product_submissions"."status" = 'APPROVED' and
        "seller_product_submissions"."review_started_at" is not null and
        "seller_product_submissions"."reviewed_at" is not null and
        "seller_product_submissions"."review_reason" is null
      ) or (
        "seller_product_submissions"."status" = 'REJECTED' and
        "seller_product_submissions"."review_started_at" is not null and
        "seller_product_submissions"."reviewed_at" is not null and
        "seller_product_submissions"."review_reason" is not null
      ) or (
        "seller_product_submissions"."status" in ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED', 'WITHDRAWN') and
        "seller_product_submissions"."review_started_at" is null and
        "seller_product_submissions"."reviewed_at" is null and
        "seller_product_submissions"."review_reason" is null
      )

seller_applications_kra_pin_type_check.name: seller_applications_kra_pin_type_check
seller_applications_kra_pin_type_check.value:
"seller_applications"."kra_pin" is null or
        ("seller_applications"."seller_type" = 'COMPANY' and "seller_applications"."kra_pin" like 'P%') or
        ("seller_applications"."seller_type" = 'SOLE_PROPRIETOR' and "seller_applications"."kra_pin" like 'A%') or
        "seller_applications"."seller_type" = 'REGISTERED_BUSINESS'

seller_applications_submission_check.name: seller_applications_submission_check
seller_applications_submission_check.value:
"seller_applications"."status" not in ('SUBMITTED', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') or (
        "seller_applications"."submitted_at" is not null and
        "seller_applications"."terms_version" is not null and
        "seller_applications"."terms_accepted_at" is not null and
        "seller_applications"."kra_pin" is not null and
        (
          ("seller_applications"."seller_type" = 'SOLE_PROPRIETOR' and "seller_applications"."registration_number" is null) or
          ("seller_applications"."seller_type" in ('COMPANY', 'REGISTERED_BUSINESS') and "seller_applications"."registration_number" is not null)
        )
      )

seller_applications_draft_check.name: seller_applications_draft_check
seller_applications_draft_check.value:
"seller_applications"."status" <> 'DRAFT' or (
        "seller_applications"."terms_version" is null and
        "seller_applications"."terms_accepted_at" is null and
        "seller_applications"."submitted_at" is null
      )

seller_applications_review_check.name: seller_applications_review_check
